key_insight: VeriCUA verifies computer-agent task completion by actively gathering evidence rather than judging only fixed observations or accessible application state.
engineering_relevance: A shared verification procedure across desktop, mobile, and web environments could reduce platform-specific engineering for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning.
method: Inspect available context and construct a task-completion rubric.
Select GUI or code checks to investigate unresolved requirements.
Combine findings under explicit evidence rules in online and offline settings.
evidence_signal: Experiments report better agreement with reference labels than compared baselines, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online.
watch_item: Active exploration introduces additional checks whose runtime cost and dependence on available GUI or code access should be assessed in deployment.
paper_title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
